dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: GEARs may get you some upgrades here and there but in this world CRED is everything. Without it you're a nobody. Do you have any?

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: Oh you poor pitiful nobody. Maybe if you finished this obstacle course I could part with some of my massive horde of CRED for you. You know, like charity.
